registry.description: Pride is the inner conviction of one's own superiority — the heart that refuses to occupy its proper place as creature before Creator and equal before equal. The Hebrew vocabulary is extensive: arrogance, haughtiness, the lifting up of oneself, the refusal to bow. Scripture treats pride as the foundational human disorder — the sin beneath sins — because it is the root from which the refusal to trust and obey God grows. God opposes the proud. Yet the same vocabulary is used positively for the legitimate confidence of those who know who they are in God.
